description: Self-contained authority verification cases: each carries the record, the registry and the verifier clock, so a port needs no fixture of its own. expect is ok or a failure code from section 6 of AUTHORITY_SPEC.md.

cases.name: valid T1
cases.note: software witness at the T1 target

cases.name: valid T2 root
cases.note: software witness at the T2 target

cases.name: valid T3 root
cases.note: software witness at the T3 target

cases.name: valid asic labelled
cases.note: witness_kind and entropy labels are accepted values

cases.name: certificate not signed by the registered key
certificate operator differs from record operator
malformed session key
cases.note: 32 bytes instead of a compressed key

cases.name: record signature has the wrong length
T1 scoped to another address
cases.note: T1 may only act on the operator's own address

cases.name: certificate scope does not cover the record
cases.note: registration grants *, certificate only the operator

cases.name: registered authority does not cover the record
cases.note: certificate grants *, registration only the operator

cases.name: boot node signs T2
cases.note: T2 needs root co-attestation, which is not on the wire yet

cases.name: target of another tier
cases.note: T1 record claiming the T2 target

cases.name: header tier differs from the record tier
witness above the target
cases.note: consistent header and hash, but nonce not mined

cases.name: session retired before the certificate started
session retired exactly when the certificate started
retired session verified after its retirement (known limitation)
cases.note: ACCEPTED today: the signature does not cover an issue time, so retirement only bounds certificates, not use; see AUTHORITY_SPEC section 10 D1
